name: Bond Duration Crisis Hedge Overlay
description: Stress-triggered overlay that dynamically tilts weight toward long-duration government bonds (VUTY/AGGU) when equity markets experience significant drawdown. Starts with equal-weight base and tilts toward the configured hedge asset when equity blend drawdown from 6-month high falls below trigger threshold. Based on the premise that long-duration bonds provide a safe-haven hedge during equity market stress due to negative correlation during crises. Tilt decays back to base weights over subsequent rebalances.
